title: 48 nabbed, P1.7-M ‘shabu’ seized in Caraga anti-drug ops

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Police arrested 48 drug suspects and confiscated at least P1.7 million worth of suspected shabu during a weeklong series of synchronized anti-criminality operations across Caraga (Region 13), a police official said Monday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office-13 (PRO-13) director, said that police operatives seized a total of 257.31 grams of alleged shabu valued at P1,749,732.48 during the Simultaneous Anti-Criminality Law Enforcement Operations (SACLEO) conducted from Sept. 28 to Oct. 4. Data from PRO-13 Regional Operations Division showed that the Surigao del Norte Police Provincial Office (PPO) netted the largest haul, confiscating 121.95 grams valued […]...
